maya: Quick async check for Q4 OKR milestone — please drop a one-line status: shipped/slipped, owner, and the immediate next action. Trying to close the milestone doc by EOD Fri. pinging @alex @jon @sam @lina :mag: 

alex: Shipped ✅ — Feature flag rollout for `model-routing-v2` is at 100% in prod. Owner: alex. Next: monitor perf for 24h, then close ticket. 

jon: Partially slipped — Cache eviction tuning didn't land due to test flakiness. Owner: jon. Next: I have a fix branch, need one reviewer. @maya can you assign a reviewer from infra? :pray: 

maya: @jon assigning @sam as reviewer, thanks. Sam can you take a look by EOD?

sam: On it, will review in the afternoon. If tests still flake I'll try reproducing locally.

lina: Blocked — Analytics event schema change is pending legal sign-off (data retention question). Owner: lina. Next: meeting with legal tomorrow 10am PT. If not approved, we'll stub events and continue. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

alex: Note — cross-team dep: rollout needs the new infra IAM role from eng-infra (ticket INF-332). If that role isn't ready we fallback to legacy routing. Owner for role: infra-ops.

maya: Thanks Alex. Filing the cross-team dependency in the milestone doc and notifying infra-ops.

jon: Quick CR ping — @alex I left a comment on your PR about the telemetry naming. small rename needed before merge.

alex: saw it, fixing now.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for alex/model-routing-v2 at 2039123780 on prod-us-west. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/2039123780

sam: Reviewed jon's fix, tests stable locally. @jon please rebase and I'll approve.

jon: Rebased and pushed. Thanks @sam.

maya: Summary for milestone doc (one-line each):
- model-routing-v2: shipped (alex) — monitor 24h then close
- cache-tuning: slipped (jon) — reviewer assigned, fix pushed
- analytics-schema: blocked (lina) — legal sign-off meeting 10am PT
- infra-iam: dep open (infra-ops) — notified

maya: If anyone else has a last-minute slip or blocker post here. Otherwise I'll update the milestone doc and mark owners. :white_check_mark:
